source.text: Fuel alpha 3e-5 per K (a synthetic figure) against 1e-5 for the cladding closes the 20 micron gap with a free overlap of 11.939 micron; the contact pressure is that overlap over the sum of the compliances of the two cylinders (plane strain: the solid fuel's (1 + nu)(1 - 2 nu) R / E and the thick cladding tube's Lame bore compliance).
source.check: FEED's independent solution (src/core/thermoElastic.ts) gives the same pressure to 1e-9 in tests/thermoElastic.test.ts (the interference test written from these compliances); the real-solver sweep of M3 finds the penalty contact 1.1 % low at the factor 0.5 for equal moduli (2 % at 0.3), which is why the tolerance is 4 %.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin at 10 W/m in a 600 K coolant, both solids linear elastic (E 200 GPa, nu 0.3) stress-free at 300 K, constant conductivities; thermo-elastic, small strain, no creep, plasticity or swelling; axially fixed, fuel alpha 3e-5 per K, cladding alpha 1e-5 per K, penalty factor 0.5, the 20 micron gap closes
